mode: reference image edit followed by deterministic facial-region compositing
masterRule: Each edit uses only that character's approved base-neutral.png as identity and alignment master. Pixel-lock canvas, body, pose, face geometry, hair silhouette and bang groups, accessory, complete outfit construction, proportions, hands and crop. Preserve clean Japanese anime linework, flat cel color, one hard-edged shadow and matte skin. Change only eyebrows, eyelids/eyes and mouth; shy may add faint cheek blush. Avoid identity drift, glossy/oily skin, gradients, painterly or 3D rendering, Western anatomy, extra accessories, text and watermark.
transparencyRule: Request real RGBA transparency. If the generator bakes a checkerboard or backdrop, never ship it directly: composite only the face ellipses onto the approved transparent master with tools/compose-expression.ps1. Final alpha and every non-face pixel come from the master.
